asus-helper-cli — управление демоном из:
asus-helper-cli — control the daemon from a terminal.

asus-helper-cli                         status
asus-helper-cli profile [quiet|balanced|performance|next]
asus-helper-cli auto on|off             profile by power source
asus-helper-cli charge 80               battery charge limit, %
asus-helper-cli epp PROFILE VALUE|default
asus-helper-cli fan [PROFILE]           fan curves
asus-helper-cli fan set PROFILE cpu|gpu 30:0,50:10,…   8 points "°C:%"
asus-helper-cli fan reset PROFILE cpu|gpu              back to the BIOS curve
asus-helper-cli fan factory             factory curves of the current profile
asus-helper-cli power                   power limits
asus-helper-cli power set PROFILE ATTR VALUE|default
asus-helper-cli power reset PROFILE
asus-helper-cli gpu                    GPU status
asus-helper-cli gpu eco|standard [--force] [--display]   turn NVIDIA off / on
                                     --force closes programs using it, --display — even with a monitor on NVIDIA
asus-helper-cli gpu auto on|off        "Auto": Eco on battery, NVIDIA on AC
asus-helper-cli kbd [0-3]              keyboard backlight brightness
asus-helper-cli kbd timeout AC BATTERY   turn off after N idle seconds (0 — never)
asus-helper-cli aura static|breathe|cycle|strobe [#RRGGBB] [#RRGGBB] [slow|normal|fast]
asus-helper-cli aura power awake,boot,sleep,shutdown   when to light up (list what you need)
asus-helper-cli slash [0-3] [ANIMATION] [pause 0-5]   lid lighting (0 — off)
asus-helper-cli slash options battery,lid            light up: on battery, with the lid closed
asus-helper-cli boost PROFILE on|off                 CPU Turbo Boost in a profile
asus-helper-cli language ru|en        program language (daemon and window restart)
asus-helper-cli diag                 what Asus-helper found on this laptop (no daemon needed, for bug reports)
  asus-helper-cli restore              restore factory power limits, BIOS fan curves, Turbo Boost
asus-helper-cli import-asusd            import settings from /etc/asusd (root, daemon stopped)
